description.value: The Nazko Branch is a small community library branch of the Cariboo Regional District Library, serving the remote Nazko area of BC's Central Interior. It is one of 15 branches across the CRD library network and is staffed by community librarian Tammy Aiello. For touring cyclists passing through this sparsely populated region, it represents one of the few public institutions in the area.
